## Phase Boundary

Enable reviewers to approve or reject skill edits with RBAC enforcement. This phase implements the skill edit review workflow that allows reviewers to see pending edits, approve or reject them with notes, and have approved edits become the active skill version while rejected edits return to submitter for revision.
